# SOHO Residence & Hotel
> Boutique Serviced Apartment-Hotel in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

SOHO Residence & Hotel is a boutique serviced apartment-hotel located at 100 Co Giang Street, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It offers premium Studio, 2-Bedroom, and 3-Bedroom residences with private kitchens, refrigerators, private balconies, and individual washing machines.

## Key Information
- Address: 100 Cô Giang, Phường Cầu Ông Lãnh, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
- Hotline / iMessage / Zalo / WhatsApp: +84 91 771 9966
- WeChat / KakaoTalk: sohoresidencehotel
- Email: booking@sohoresidencehotel.vn
- Official Website: https://sohoresidencehotel.vn

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn): SOHO Residence & Hotel official homepage.
- [Studio Apartment](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/studio): 30 m² open-plan apartment with private balcony, washer, and kitchen. Sleeps 1–2.
- [2-Bedroom Apartment](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/2-bedroom): 55 m² residence with 2 bedrooms, living room, balcony, washer, and kitchen. Sleeps 3–4.
- [3-Bedroom Apartment](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/3-bedroom): 95 m² residence with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, spacious living area, balcony, washer, and kitchen. Sleeps 5–6.
- [All Rooms](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/rooms): Overview of all serviced apartment types at SOHO.
- [About Us](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/about): Story, values, and location of SOHO Residence & Hotel.
- [Contact](https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/contact): Direct reservation, support phone numbers, and messaging channels.
